PM Modi Meets Commonwealth Games Medal Winners

Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with Indian medal winners from the Commonwealth Games 2026 at his residence on Tuesday. The meeting was scheduled for 4 PM. The Prime Minister lauded the athletes for their performances. A special reel with the theme 'Jo Khelega Vo Khilega' (He who plays, will bloom) was also shared.
